tasks.description: Retire season_override from the active owner condition sync projection while preserving stored snapshots and public seasonal facts.
constraints: Current backend base c8ad7d6 or controller metadata-only follow-up. Return a valid unified Git diff with exact source context. Controller applies and verifies.

The active normal plant create/edit APIs already reject newly supplied season_override and production analysis jobs accept a closed list of inputs. Current owner_sync_entries still returns the historical season_override field for condition_snapshots. Remove only that JSON key from the active owner sync projection with one forward migration. Preserve exact other JSON fields and tombstones, column types, view options, ownership and ACL; don't change fetch_sync_delta profile/entitlement behavior or dependency order for deployments without 024. Prefer the smallest fail-closed transformation of current view definition targeting exactly one occurrence, with tests against real PostgreSQL deparsing. Use the same internal view and canonical fetch path.

Keep all stored condition_snapshot values and pinned diagnoses byte-for-byte. Preserve old light provenance and public seasonal catalogue facts. No changes to historical migrations, table storage or writes, jobs/provider, catalogue, entitlement/notification projections, Edge or iOS. No live deployment in this task. T169 remains open for broader clients and verified integration.

Extend plant_edit_conditions.test.sql with version-compatible checks using an explicit view comment marker or equivalent. Verify old and new snapshots still store winter, canonical owner feed full and delta omit only season_override, other snapshot keys and historically confirmed light remain, and cross-owner access stays blocked. Retain earlier cutoff fixture behavior.
